Filed by Raw Labs, Inc. pursuant to Rule 425 under the Securities Act of 1933.

Subject Company: Target Wireless, Inc. Commission File No. 000-12345

Raw Labs Announces Intention to Commence Hostile Exchange Offer for Target Wireless. The proposed offer is expected to consist of a mix of cash and Raw Labs common stock.

The parties announced an agreement to combine in an all-stock merger of equals, and the transaction is expected to be completed in the second half of 2026.

Raw Labs has access to an equity line of credit with a headline capacity of up to $100 million. The combined company will have a broad development pipeline of products.

Additional documents filed by Raw Labs with the SEC may be obtained free of charge at the SEC website.

Any legal suit, action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Note shall be instituted exclusively in the state or federal courts, and no failure or delay by a party in exercising any right shall operate as a waiver.

The holder shall not make any claim against the Trust Account or Public Distributions, and all such claims are Released Claims under this Note.

On May 1, 2026, Raw Labs held a special meeting of stockholders. At the close of business on March 15, 2026, the record date for the Special Meeting, there were 56,959,141 shares outstanding.
